title: Bar Test (Human Rated)
claimTested: Spoon can sustain natural conversation without requiring API-shaped reformulation.

phases.purpose: Record a human-rated unscripted conversation session; this fixture is a manual protocol, not an answer key.

input.prompt: Run the 30-minute Bar Test conversation protocol from ekg-benchmark-suite/10-bar-test.md.

criteria: human rates continuity, repair, memory, uncertainty, and helpfulness on a 1–5 scale

phases.purpose: Repeat the same conversational evaluation with Teacher removed.

input.prompt: Run the 30-minute Bar Test conversation protocol from ekg-benchmark-suite/10-bar-test.md with Teacher OFF.

criteria: human records the same 12 dimensions and overall 1–5 judgment
